progress.command: gh "pr" "create" "--base" "main" "--head" "fix/nested-run-guard" "--title" "fix: stop a pi-action run that the agent starts inside a run" "--body" "\"Follow-up to #66 ([comment](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/66#issuecomment-6866884832)).\\n\\n## What happened\\n\\nIn [run 43520110827](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43520110827/job/132211946823), the agent ran `node src/index.ts` (from pit's `shell.execFile`) as a smoke test. The child had the step's environment: the event, the `INPUT_*` values, and the tokens. So it ran the action again on issue #66 in the same checkout. It committed to `refs/pi-action/threads/66` under the outer run, whose `GitStorage` then failed its compare-and-swap (`Ref refs/pi-action/threads/66 moved`), and the run failed.\\n\\n## Change\\n\\n- New `src/nested-run.ts`: `claimRun(env)` sets `PI_ACTION_RUNNING=<pid>` in pi-action's own `process.env`. Every tool and child process inherits it: `bash`, and also pit, which runs in the pi-action process and spawns from its environment.\\n- `src/index.ts` calls it first. When the variable is already set, the step fails at once (`setFailed`), before it reads the inputs or touches a ref.\\n- `src/push.ts` (the `Save pi thread state` step) pushes nothing inside a run, with a warning. The real push step is a new process without the variable, so it still works.\\n- Docs: \\\"A run inside a run\\\" in `docs/security.md`, and the new file in CONTRIBUTING's source table.\\n\\n## Tests\\n\\n- `claimRun` / `nestedRun`: marks, refuses with the outer run's mark kept, ignores an empty value.\\n- `node src/index.ts` and `node src/push.ts` under plain Node with the variable set: exit 1 with the error, and exit 0 with the warning. The children get only `PATH` and the variable, so if the guard broke, they would find no event or token to act on.\\n\\n`npm run check` passes.\\n\\n## Release note\\n\\n```markdown\\n### Fixed\\n- **A run that the agent starts inside a run stops at once** (#NN). If the agent ran pi-action again from its tools, the second run changed the thread refs under the first, and the first run failed. pi-action now sets `PI_ACTION_RUNNING` while it runs and does not start when it is set. See [A run inside a run](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/vX.Y.Z/docs/security.md#a-run-inside-a-run).\\n```\""
